tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App and page background. Warm off-white; never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, bottom nav, inputs. Sits on surface-page with shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, progress-bar track, map placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Hero cards (HONK, next-up, score), dark buttons. Text on it uses ink-inverse or ink-inverse-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline dividers between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed borders on hint rows and empty slots, inactive step dots, outline buttons. Decorative, not for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-page and surface-card. Also the Goose's outline.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy that supports a headline; inactive tab labels. 7:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, captions, timestamps, overlines. Lowest text colour allowed: 5.0:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse, accent and danger fills.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav and tab, links, overlines like NEXT UP. Passes 4.5:1 for small text on surface-card and surface-page; use it for all terracotta text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for accent links and buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Icon-tile and tip-banner fills behind accent icons.

tokens.name: accent-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Terracotta text or dots on surface-inverse (6.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-terracotta
tokens.usage: The original brand terracotta. Decorative only: Goose blush, illustration, text 24px and up. Fails 4.5:1 for small text, so never use for body copy or labels.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: SOS, emergency numbers, destructive actions (delete account), error icons.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger icons.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Checks, Completed chips, activity and ticket bookings.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success icons and chips.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Flights, translate, trusted-traveler docs, upcoming-trip date chip.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info icons.

tokens.name: stay
tokens.usage: Hotel and stay bookings only.

tokens.name: stay-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind stay icons.

tokens.name: weather-sun
tokens.usage: Sun icon stroke. Icon only, never text.

tokens.name: goose-feather
tokens.usage: Goose body and head fill.

tokens.name: goose-wing
tokens.usage: Goose wings.

tokens.name: goose-beak
tokens.usage: Goose upper beak.

tokens.name: goose-beak-shade
tokens.usage: Goose lower beak.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state copy; inputs (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cold after sunset. Bring a layer.
styles.usage: Default body and list rows (500 for row titles, 600 for emphasis).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, in ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section and card overlines, always UPPERCASE, in ink-muted or accent.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Nav labels, timestamps, AI disclaimers. Smallest size allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between title and its meta line; segmented-track padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and paired buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; icon-to-text gap in rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Onboarding side gutter; gap above primary actions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the home indicator on full-bleed screens.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Marketing and logo clear space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small icon buttons, step badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, header icon buttons, booking icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List-group cards, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards; bottom-nav top corners.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners); logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars and status dots.

shadow.note: Clay depth: soft warm drop shadow plus a faint inset bottom edge so surfaces read as pressed clay. Shadows are tinted brown, never grey.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Default card and list group.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The one hero card per screen; tool tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-inverse
tokens.usage: surface-inverse hero cards.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Primary accent buttons and the FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: shadow-field
tokens.usage: Search and text inputs (sunken).

size.note: Fixed sizes for the phone layout (390 x 844 reference frame).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target for any control.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Standard button; 52–54px for the single primary action on a screen.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation including home-indicator padding.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Nav and tile icons; 1.8px stroke.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline row icons; 1.8–2px stroke.
